question: How many divisions are there on a vernier scale as used in a modern vernier caliper for metric measurement?
solution:
The correct answer is __50**(Option 4)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Vernier scale__ is a measuring tool used to measure small lengths with high precision.
 
• The modern metric vernier caliper typically has 50 divisions on its vernier scale.
 
• The divisions on the vernier scale are compared to the main scale to determine precise measurements.
 
• This allows a least count or precision of 0.02 mm.
 
• It is widely used in engineering and scientific applications to measure dimensions accurately.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Least Count:**

 
 
• The least count of a vernier caliper is the smallest measurement it can precisely measure.
 
• For the metric vernier caliper, the least count is 0.02 mm.
 
 
 
• **Usage:**
 
 
• Vernier calipers are used in precision engineering, scientific experiments, and manufacturing.
 
• They are ideal for measuring internal, external, and depth dimensions.
